meta.author: Glint
meta.notes: Built in, from public knowledge; still to be checked on real samples. Doorbell and camera events: the camera's name as the title, what it saw as the text, a snapshot as a big picture (the face's background from Large up), with how long ago. Doors and locks: "front door open", "since 7:55 am", for as long as the notification is up; closed or locked goes back to the plain tile. If Home Assistant already sees the cameras, prefer an HA tile. Channel ids are guesses. A doorbell ring may come as category call; only the event's wording is relied on.

event.regex: (?i)(?P<v>someone(?: is)? at the door|someone rang the doorbell|doorbell rang|package (?:seen|detected|delivered)|person (?:seen|detected)|motion (?:seen|detected)|animal (?:seen|detected))
